about_the_game:
"You are the best of this lot."

Wield high-tech firearms, rockets, and lasers against incoming enemy hordes! This action Roguelike hinges on pivotal "Quest Param" choices that forge your path to power. Unearth ancient artifacts that unlock revolutionary combat tactics.

《Mugen RPG》 is a top-down, fast-paced action Roguelike game. As a newcomer struggling to survive, you'll be thrown into a life-or-death trial across different worlds. Relying on cutting-edge weaponry and the emergent enhancements found in battle, you must fight through a hail of bullets against tides of enemies and formidable bosses. Every adventure is a fresh start. Acquire "Quest Params" through combat and freely construct your unique fighting style. Will you become a master of firepower clearing screens in an instant, or an unshakeable bastion on the battlefield? Your choices define everything.

Core Features:

  • Infinite Build Possibilities: A vast array of "Quest Params" offers endless combinations to create your ultimate combat form.

  • Auto-Fire, Focus on Strategy: Weapons attack automatically, letting you concentrate on movement, decision-making, and high-skill maneuvers.

  • Challenge the Unknown: Encounter diverse enemy swarms with distinct behaviors and uniquely designed powerful Bosses. Every encounter is a new test.

  • Mysterious Artifacts, Turn the Tide: Find and wield ancient creations holding mysterious powers; they will bring unexpected variables and aid to your adventures.
